name: AppNavBar
description: Top-level application navigation bar with logo, menu items, and user profile area. Provides a consistent header across the application with support for branded logos, navigation links with active states, and a user information slot.

notes: Renders as a <nav> element with aria-label for landmark identification.
Active navigation items are indicated with aria-current='page'.
All interactive items must be keyboard accessible with visible focus indicators.

title.description: Application title displayed in the navigation bar.

logo.description: Logo element rendered at the start of the navigation bar.

items.description: Array of navigation items to render in the main navigation area.

userInfo.description: Content rendered at the end of the navigation bar, typically user profile information.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the root element.

do: Use AppNavBar as the primary top-level navigation for your application.
Provide a meaningful aria-label to distinguish this navigation landmark.
Use the userInfo slot for profile menus or user-related actions.
dont: Do not nest AppNavBar inside another navigation component.
Do not use AppNavBar for secondary or sidebar navigation.
Do not place more than one AppNavBar on a single page.
